theme: An open day, and a board that wants tending.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan — the whole day is yours. The real pull is the household board: a couple of overdue items and tomorrow's Sunday review with Mike.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A p1 on the household board is nearly two weeks overdue. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out early — book it refundable now and adjust the dates later.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 9 AM you and Mike run the 15-minute Sunday review. A glance at the 'Dan & Mike Stuff' board tonight means you arrive knowing what's active and what's slipped.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England committee note
needsAttention.detail: A forwarded note about joining the NACDNE Maine programming committee bounced off your old address and landed in your inbox today — the sender is asking whether you got it.

needsAttention.title: Term-life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Your task to pull three term-life quotes came due yesterday; it's waiting on a target coverage amount and term length before it can move.

flagged.title: Gov & multilateral affairs role
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced a Senior Director, Government & Multilateral Affairs posting via Jobgether.

flagged.title: AbeBooks sign-in attempt
flagged.detail: A sign-in attempt on your AbeBooks account from Florida on an iPhone, Sept 24 — likely you, but worth a glance.

inbox.noise: The rest is an Airbnb referral promo, an AbeBooks order receipt, and a BBYO reunion Evite.

resolved.title: ICGN panel — you're moderating
resolved.detail: You accepted the moderating slot at the ICGN Toronto event; Elizabeth Thomas confirmed and speaker logistics are on their way to you.

recipe.title: Chicken, Sherry, Almond Pot Roast
recipe.why: A slow autumn braise for cooler evenings, when a warm pot on the stove earns its keep.

tasks.title: Plan the Pathfinder drive south (Oct 5–18 window)

acts.line: The calendar is clear straight through — no meetings anywhere on today.
Still nothing scheduled; the overdue items on the household board would use the quiet well.
Tomorrow opens at 9 with the Sunday review, so a look at the board tonight sets it up.
